newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian president said making steady recovery.
newsitem.headline: Austrian president said making steady recovery.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil is making a steady recovery from a severe form of pneumonia but is not yet ready to resume his official duties, a spokesman for his office said on Wednesday.

Klestil, 63, was admitted to Vienna general hospital on September 14 and was transferred to intensive care when his condition deteriorated. Chancellor Franz Vranitzky assumed Klestil's duties on September 24.
"The President is making continuous progress from an extremely obstinate form of pneumonia but no date has been set for the resumption of his official duties," the spokesman said.
